title: SessionOutputGap
description: Params for the session.outputGap notification. It states a missing half-open range in the session output byte coordinate; it does not carry terminal bytes or reset terminal state.

sessionId.description: The server-minted session id whose live output stream crossed a gap.

end.description: The first byte offset after the missing range.

reason.description: The reason recorded for the gap. Unknown values must be reported without guessing.
